add_sources.note: Official site: 'Pestapora Music Festival 25, 26, 27 September 2026'; linked from @pestapora Instagram bio.
Site footer: 'Promoted by Boss Creator' (bosscreator.id); copyright 2026 BOSS CREATOR.
Google snippet: annual festival in Jakarta organised by promoter Boss Creator. Kompas (2022) names Boss Creator director Kiki Aulia Ucup.
@pestapora uses the title 'Pestapora Pasti SIMPATI' throughout Sep 2026 (stages incl. 'Pestapora Stage Pestapora Pasti SIMPATI'); @simpati co-authored 8 posts.
@pestapora (26 Sep 2026): BRImo booth with VIP parking, fast track, prize games, Apple auction and Gold Bar Challenge; tickets sold via Loket.com and BRImo; BRI merchant partners in Hall D2.
'Klab Klub Stage @extrajoss_ultimate' (stage branding); Extra Joss booth (https://www.instagram.com/p/DdoXmYco_4Q/).
FC Mobile area at JIExpo Kemayoran with Timnas Indonesia activities and signed jersey prizes; 'Pesta Jersey' with @easfcmobileid.
@pestapora: ride to Pestapora on @yamahaindonesia motorbikes (Grand Filano, Fazzio).
Pack context (1 Oct 2026): 'Big thank you to @alphathetaindonesia for sponsoring the DJ equipment that made our Micro Disco happen.'
Google snippet: Yummy presented 'Masakpora', an interactive cooking experience at Pestapora 2026.
Google snippet of a @pestapora 2026 post: 'Kalau batuk dan gangguan tenggorokan datang? Ingat yang ada COMBI' (sponsored product message).
'Barang-barang bisa membantu kalian nonton Pestapora ... kolaborasi bareng @rumahatsiri, @bagasi.destinasi, @typesee.eyewear & @hydroflask.id'.
Context: Pestapora ended its 2025 sponsorship with PT Freeport Indonesia on 6 Sep 2025 after dozens of acts withdrew (Kompas, Magdalene).

notes: 2026 ran as 'Pestapora Pasti SIMPATI' (Telkomsel naming), with BRImo, Extra Joss, Mentos, FC Mobile and Yamaha activations. COMBI (a cough and throat product) ran in-feed messages: a health-adjacent precedent. 2025 Freeport sponsorship caused artist withdrawals and was dropped mid-festival, so sponsor vetting is sensitive for this audience.
